question: In the BatPaC comparison, how much lower are the total pack cost and the material cost with Co-free cathodes than with NCA cathodes?

trace.query: SELECT id, text, value, unit, role, about, quantity FROM measures WHERE sentence ILIKE '%Co-free cathodes%' AND page = 3
SELECT id, page, text FROM lines WHERE page = 3 AND id LIKE 'p3.L16%'

SELECT id, text, value, unit, role, about, quantity FROM measures WHERE page = 3 AND (text ILIKE '%8500%' OR text ILIKE '%3500%' OR text ILIKE '%10 000%' OR text ILIKE '%5000%' OR text ILIKE '%000%')

SELECT CAST(replace(regexp_extract(a.text,'\(\$([0-9 ]+) total pack',1),' ','') AS INT) - CAST(regexp_extract(b.text,'\(\$([0-9]+) total pack',1) AS INT) AS diff FROM lines a, lines b WHERE a.id='p3.L19' AND b.id='p3.L18'
